recommended_treatment: Use the loan-specific SEC-supported listing rate through a versioned working-data overlay for these 148 confirmed cases; preserve raw values and source references.
scope: The existing F.3 2010–2015, 36-month, policy-1 Individual candidate pool, excluding the specified noncreditpolicy prefix. The existing terminal-status filter remains separate and unchanged.

identification_rule.step_1: Across every included vintage, flag the union of (a) stored rate exactly 6%, (b) a raw-versus-saved-archive rate discrepancy, and (c) a sparse off-grid rate cell.
identification_rule.sparse_cell_definition: Exact CSV issue-month x subgrade; at least 20 loans; at most 2 at the rate; over 3 percentage points from the nearest tied modal non-6% rate. Ties are retained, not broken arbitrarily.
identification_rule.step_2: A flag is only a search lead. Change a working rate only where that exact loan has a source-linked listed-rate candidate, the expected stored value matches, and no observed listing-rate conflict remains. Do not use grade/month or payment arithmetic to set a rate.
identification_rule.step_3: Version the approved ledger if adopted. Newly discovered flags, changed raw fingerprints, conflicting versions or uncovered IDs must stop for evidence review, rather than receive an automatic rate.
identification_rule.limitations: The archive and diagnostic screens are not exhaustive. Nearby-grid changes can escape. First-ever and investor-specific commitment versions are not universally certified.

when_adopted_consistent_uses: F.5 int_rate predictor; one rate feature only
F.12 platform-pricing block including sub_grade and the same int_rate
audit_only_not_predictors: Original stored rates kept alongside the sourced value for lineage
Source URLs, evidence levels and version metadata
no_change_to: F.8 observed cash amounts or formulas
